proposal.review: Trials 1 and 2 are both primary word-route logistic runs with swap augmentation. Trial 1: search accuracy 0.6228, train accuracy 0.8146, gap 0.1918. Trial 2: search accuracy 0.6216, train accuracy 0.8443, gap 0.2227. Class recalls are approximately balanced. Trial 2 configuration fact check confirmed logistic; trial 1 fitted estimator was logistic though not declared. No failures are recorded.
proposal.hypothesis: word_char_C0.05 will test whether character n-gram features alter search accuracy relative to word_C0.05; direction and magnitude are unknown.
proposal.uncertainty: Only two primary word-route trials are available; no confirmation split or formal test is available. The observed train-search gap may indicate overfitting, but a representation change could reduce, leave unchanged, or worsen search accuracy. This is diagnostic, not a predicted improvement.
